title: Toerisme Vlaanderen: accessibility of tourist places in Flanders and Brussels
description: Accessibility information about about a thousand tourist places in Flanders and Brussels (museums, restaurants, youth hostels, hotels, holiday homes, tourist offices, nature areas, attractions) from Toerisme Vlaanderen's linked open data. Includes the official accessibility labels A and A+ (awarded after an audit), flags for the groups a place caters for (motor, visual, blind, auditive, deaf, mental, autism, allergies), and texts per topic (entrance, route and levels, toilets, rooms, parking) in Dutch and English, with coordinates. Refreshed daily from Toerisme Vlaanderen's own export of its linked data.
licence_note: No licence published yet; Toerisme Vlaanderen's open data page says its datasets may be used without registration. To be confirmed with Toerisme Vlaanderen.

assessment.note: a_label A or A+ is the Toerisme Vlaanderen accessibility label (about 400 places). Other places carry accessibility information registered with Toerisme Vlaanderen, without a label; how it was collected is not stated per place.
